lineWidth.description: The width of a line the formatter will try to stay under. Note that this limit will be exceeded in some cases.

indentWidth.description: The number of spaces for an indent.

blankLinesUpperBound.description: The maximum number of consecutive blank lines allowed.

reorderImportItems.description: Whether to sort the items of an import statement alphabetically.

wrapMode.description: How to wrap text in markup.

oneOf.description: Wraps text to fit within the line width.
Places each sentence on its own line.
